description: Record that an incident a source has already resolved is resolved: "resolution confirmed by <you>", with an optional note (the fix commit, the PR, an evidence link). It shows in the sheet and in History, and the operator log records the write. It changes no state, so it cannot hide anything: use it after you checked that the fix held. Refused for an incident that is firing, one that never resolved, and one that was marked resolved by hand while a source still reports it.

by.description: Who is doing this, as "agent: <who>", for example "agent: claude in web-app". Required: it is shown on the tile, in the incident sheet and in History. "agent: " is added when left off. At most 64 characters.

key.description: The incident key exactly as watch_state or list_incidents print it ("<service>|<rule>", or "<service>|<rule>|<instance>" for a rule split per instance). Not an alert key.

note.description: A sentence of context, at most 500 characters: a fix commit, a PR, what you found. Longer findings go in a comment.

name: confirm_resolution
title: Confirm an incident is resolved
